title: built-in parameter definitions
description: Authoritative loader definition: published JSON Schemas and the type registry are generated from this corpus. Reuse existing native types; add definitions only for actual pack instances. The remaining user-listed types (region box and surface; events drop_into, attach, surface and timeout; prop rigid_body; sensor acoustic_amplitude) are deliberately absent until their first step-4 instance.

marine_6dof.description: Current native Fossen body parameters in SI, expressed at COM. Inertia definiteness, hydrodynamic matrix validity and frame consistency are semantic checks; JSON Schema alone cannot prove them.

lagged_force.description: Signed force input in N along configured unit direction. Order/scaling of a transport array belongs to the bridge, not this model.

ahrs.description: Synchronized orientation, specific force and angular rate; no perfect orientation substituted for noisy AHRS.

reference_velocity.description: Native reference-relative sensor-point velocity, with no implicit bottom-lock gate; preserves the current Talos default.

dvl.description: Physical ideal bottom-track DVL; explicit availability and range semantics are distinct from reference_velocity.

reference_altitude.description: Existing Z-up target-point altitude report with sensor lever-arm correction; not positive-down depth or raw pressure.

pressure.description: Hydrostatic pressure and separately calibrated depth. World atmospheric pressure/density do not silently change sensor calibration.

deck_height_m.description: Deck height above the water surface in m; sets pool wall box height (depth + deck + 1).

rectangular_pool.description: Finite rectangular pool in pool-local SI units: origin at the floor-plan corner on the water surface, +Z up.

water_optics.description: Sensor-affecting water appearance for offscreen cameras, with the original renderer's validated ranges. tint_rgb is linear RGB in 0..1 (omitted: the original default [0.025, 0.22, 0.29]); distances in m; scattering and absorption per m (RGB order); other values dimensionless.

lighting.description: Sensor-affecting scene lighting for offscreen cameras. direct_light, ambient_light and glare are dimensionless multipliers; sun angles in degrees. The indoor profile uses a fixed overhead light, so the original renderer ignores sun angles and glare for it.

pinhole_intrinsics.description: Pinhole intrinsics in pixels: focal lengths fx, fy and principal point cx, cy.

right_frame.description: Rectified right-eye frame: a child of the sensor frame at [baseline_m, 0, 0] with identity orientation (semantic check). Required by right-eye outputs.

noise.description: Depth noise: sigma = base_sigma_m + range_coefficient * range^range_exponent (m); dropout and outlier fractions in 0..1; patch_size_px correlation patch in pixels.

depth.description: Depth output range limits in m and noise model. min_range_m < max_range_m is a semantic check.

stereo_camera.description: Offscreen-rendered rectified stereo camera. Baseline in m along optical +X, resolution [width, height] px (at most 4096 each), plumb-bob distortion [k1, k2, p1, p2, k3] for the left camera (metadata; rectified outputs publish zero distortion). camera_info describes the left eye; right-eye outputs require right_frame.

projectile.description: Released projectile, SI units. Centers are axial offsets in m along +X nose from the body center. finned_rigid_body requires the four rotational fields; fixed_axis_body (non-rotating integrator) forbids them.

slots.description: Ordered release slots in the mechanism frame; projectile nose is slot +X. Fire order is list order.

payload_release.description: Shared payload release parameters: slots, projectile, launch energy in J, cooldown in s (shared by mechanisms in the same cooldown_group), and slot capacity. capacity vs slot count is a semantic check.

launcher.description: Torpedo launcher: spring-launched payload release whose launch speed adds the vehicle point velocity.

dropper.description: Dropper: payload release with gravity-driven drop from slots oriented nose-down.

pads.description: Asset ids of the left and right pad contact representations.

timed_command.description: Command is a signed duration: >0 open for |d| s, <0 close for |d| s, 0 stop.

completion_tolerance_m.description: Per-jaw remaining travel at which motion status becomes complete.

claw.description: Two-jaw claw in SI: gaps and margins in m, jaw speed per jaw in m/s, hold force in N, dwell in s, friction dimensionless. min_gap_m < max_gap_m is a semantic check.

magnet.description: Magnet tip position in m in the mechanism frame; actuated false means passive (proximity is judged by the task pack).

material.description: Renderer surface class for this placement: asset (default: the mesh's own materials), liner (corrugated liner shading), clear (blended translucent cover) or emissive (self-lit, HDR glow; radiance and the tint apply).

radiance.description: HDR radiance multiplier of an emissive placement.

indicator.description: Task visuals only: the placement's tint follows the indicator of the named region of the same task (regions with an indicator block). color_rgb maps every indicator color name to the linear RGB tint shown while that color is current.

visual.description: Rigid mesh placement: the asset id is drawn in its authored coordinates, offset by position_m (m) and orientation_wxyz in the named frame of the owning pack. Optional texture is the id of a PNG asset of the same pack that replaces the diffuse texture of the mesh's textured submeshes (of every submesh when none is textured) for this placement only.

cutouts.description: Render cutouts from a perforated_panel region on faces at these local x offsets in m.

collision_meshes.description: Optional concave triangle-mesh collision (Wavefront .obj asset, authored coordinates placed in the named frame); used by the rigid-body prop world.

static_body.description: Static task-local prop. Collision boxes in m in the task-local frame; visuals reference asset ids and frames (offsets in m); cutouts are optional. collision_meshes are optional and only consumed by the rigid-body prop world.

task_plane.description: Task-local plane normal to the given axis at offset in m.

bounds_local.description: Strict local bounds in m: |y| < abs_y_lt_m and z < z_lt_m.

frame.description: Optional task frame whose pose is the portal's local frame (default: the task frame); one task can hold several rows.

depth_band_m.description: Optional [bottom, top] z band in m in the portal frame; pass_through then emits depth_overlap, whether the crossing point plus the envelope's conservative vertical extent overlaps the band.

rectangular_portal.description: Rectangular opening crossed by the robot. Lengths in m; approach_radius_m opens/closes an attempt; a larger reference-origin jump than max_pose_step_m resets the judge. Fit check reference_origin_at_crossing accepts a crossing point with 0 < |y| < abs_y_lt_m and ignores z_lt_m and the envelope.

size.description: Size label emitted with the hit (e.g. large/small); scoring meaning is hook-owned.

holes.description: Holes in panel uv (0..1 across the 2 * half_size_m square); radius_uv is a fraction of the panel side. Hole id uniqueness is a semantic check.

projectile_clearance.description: Pass iff |hit - centre| + r / max(min_cosine, |axis . plane normal|) <= hole radius.

perforated_panel.description: Square panel of half_size_m (m) with circular holes; outside the panel no event fires.

pass_through.description: Event fired when the robot crosses the named portal region from from_side to to_side. from_side != to_side is a semantic check; region must be a rectangular_portal.

contact.description: Informational event when the robot touches the named prop; prop must exist (semantic check).

hit.description: Event fired when a projectile from the given mechanism type crosses the named perforated_panel region with the given outcome.

frame.description: Task frame of the crate; local z = 0 is the interior floor.

class.description: Class label emitted with landings (scoring meaning is hook-owned).

liner_height_fraction.description: Visual liner height as a fraction of the crate; not used by the physics.

open_crate.description: Open-topped square crate in m. Payloads of every mechanism kind collide with conservative wall proxies (solid from outside until they enter through the top opening; inner liner faces contain them afterwards) and stop on a floor or rim landing: outcome inside (entered and fully within the inner walls) or blocked.

face_orientation_wxyz.description: Face orientation relative to the frame.

sensor_offset_m.description: Sensor point in m in the face frame.

probe_mechanism_type.description: The robot's single mechanism of this type supplies the probe point (its tip_position_m).

indicator.description: Light colours for rendering; the latch is exposed in the run snapshot.

proximity_target.description: Latched proximity sensor: the robot probe point within trigger_distance_m (m) of the sensor point for a continuous dwell_s (s) latches the target until reset.

frame.description: Task frame at the octagon centre (default: the task frame).

targets.description: Task frames the robot may face.

surface.description: Water-surface region: regular octagon with sides facing 0, 45, ... degrees in the frame, inner apothem apothem_m - pipe_radius_m. Facts: surface_reached/surface_lost (submerged, inside, envelope top at the water for dwell_s), breach (envelope top above the water by breach_margin_m outside the octagon after being submerged; latches), facing_reached/facing_lost (nearest target by planar heading error within tolerance_deg for dwell_s while surfaced).

frame.description: Task frame at the zone centre (default: the task frame).

restart_events.description: Events (task, event id) that discard the travel so far.

turn_zone.description: Yaw-turn judge within radius_m of the frame origin: one-direction travel is judged in whole turns (travel + turn_tolerance_deg) / 360 when the heading holds within settle_deg for dwell_s, reverses by more than reversal_deg, or the robot leaves the zone; travel under min_travel_deg is ignored. Fact rotation_judged {reason, travel_rad, turns}.

surfaces.description: Labels reported as the event region for outcome elsewhere: floor when resting on the pool floor, support otherwise.

drop_into.description: Fired when a released prop comes to rest. in_region: inside one of the box regions (regions; region names the one); elsewhere: at rest outside all of them (surfaces required).

activate.description: Event fired when a proximity_target region latches.

surface_reached.description: Event fired when the robot has been surfaced inside the named surface region for its dwell.

surface_lost.description: Event fired when a surfaced robot leaves the surfaced state.

facing_reached.description: Event fired when the named surface region's facing dwell is met; data.target names the frame.

facing_lost.description: Event fired when a met facing dwell is lost or changes target.

breach.description: Event fired once when the robot breaches outside the named surface region.

rotation_judged.description: Event fired when a turn_zone judges its travel; data carries reason, travel_rad and turns.

rigid_body.description: Free dynamic prop. The collision shape is the convex hull of the .obj vertices centred on their bounds (centre = bounds midpoint). frame is the task-local pose of the mesh origin at reset; mass in kg, volume (buoyancy) in m^3, expected_region the box region that scores as correct. Friction/damping coefficients dimensionless except damping in 1/s; margins in m. visual_asset is the optional pack asset id of the display mesh whose origin coincides with the collision asset origin.

contact_world.description: Rigid-body prop world settings for the task: gravity, Bullet solver iterations, rest detection (speed threshold in m/s held for rest_time_s), water angular drag in N m s/rad and the quadratic drag coefficient (force = -drag_coefficient * density * wet * area * v|v|). The world grasps with the robot mechanism of claw_mechanism_type.

box.description: Oriented containment volume in a task frame. A prop is inside when its bounds-extent-inflated xy stays strictly within half_extents_xy_m, z (frame axes, m) lies in the open interval z_range_m, and it touches support_mesh (a collision mesh id) or a prop that is itself inside.

attach.description: Fired when a mechanism of the given type establishes a grasp on a prop.

detach.description: Fired when a grasp ends (released, slipped or reset).

payload_landing.description: Event fired when a payload of one of the mechanism types ends on the named open_crate region with the given outcome; data carries region_class, detail (floor or rim), projectile_id and mechanism_type. Once per payload.

event_points.description: Declarative scoring: points (may be negative) awarded per firing of the named event, up to max_awards times if given. Currently unused by packs.
